# News18

> > Comprehensive news and election coverage from News18, India's leading digital news platform

News18 provides in-depth coverage of Indian politics, elections, and current affairs with a focus on state assembly elections, local body polls, and electoral analysis across major states including West Bengal, Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Assam, and Maharashtra.

- 2026 State Elections
- West Bengal Politics
- Tamil Nadu Elections
- Kerala Assembly

- Puducherry
- Maharashtra & BMC
- Bihar & Jharkhand Elections
- Delhi Elections
- TMC & PMC
- Election Results & Exit Polls
- Voter Turnout Analysis
- Local Body Elections
